title: The Last Machine Again
author: Felix Pemberton
blurb: Ines Almeida, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
